sentences.text: The contentions are the pending Crime No punishable under Sections 498A, 313, 494, 495, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, are liable to be quashed in view of consent terms dated 27th August, 2021 tendered before the Family Court, Satara in case no. A-264 of 2021.

According to learned counsel, the Family Court based on the aforesaid consent terms, has passed a decree for dissolution of marriage under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, on 21st January, 2022.
Our attention is invited to the clause 8 of the said consent terms, which provides for withdrawal of the prosecution.

2. According to counsel, the petitioners are willing to bear the travel expenses of the respondent/complainant, so also the legal bipin prithiani 16-wp-6377.21.doc expenses for attending the present proceedings.

The petitioners shall deposit an amount of Rs.10,000/- in this Court Rajesh Anandrao Nikam And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69844425/

Learned APP waives notice for respondent no.1.

The prosecution of the petitioners for the aforesaid offence shall remain stayed until further orders.
